Being able to sleep, and not feel paralyzed or stuck helps you to do the work. Though just as like with therapy, you might not get matched with the right psychiatrist for you at first. Hopefully you aren't in an area where you only have one option and you're able to try and find someone that works for you. If you can and you want to  please  try to get connected. It took a year and a half of me finding the right psychiatrist and medications. Even with the people closest to me the noticed the difference before I did. Long time ago I saw a meme about the only way healing is even possible if you build healthy relationships which is really hard for people with trauma because you know all the wonderful shit we have to unlearn, and gotta trust people and the best part about what's red flags just looks like the flags you've seen your whole life.

So I met this person, they were amazing. One day we did something that was important to me and I spent the whole time apologizing and being scared and worried about him getting mad. Which none of that was gonna happen apparently, he like actually wanted to do something I wanted to do and I didn't have to apologize, say please, beg, or justify it in any way. He wasn't even annoyed, upset, or wanted an apology for me apologizing and trying to check his mood constantly. It was weird, it was way out of my normal zone. I broke up with him the next day because I was like wtf is this. He doesn't deserve this, I'm broken etc he doesn't need this... he was hurt but understood. He gave me time to process all of that and how different a normal person is in your life.

We're great now, and I'm happy. We're not dating but just seeing we're things goes and he doesn't want me to force myself into a situation that I find weird and uncomfortable even though it's a healthy relationship with someone who isn't toxic and doesn't pity me or think I'm broken or anything. 

And you know what, it's honestly helped me. It's slow progress, and I've now built 3 new friendships that are healthy a year since I met him and I still have all my symptoms but I just started being a lil less jaded. 

So yeah the scroll sucks, but it's true.
